_about: The grass of Military Warehouses and Experimental Pool, matte (the owner, 2026-11-14, with two places on Military Warehouses: "grass which is too glossy"). Their X-Ray detail grass has one material each, a copy of stock flora/grass_l03_alt with the grass's colour texture (build_details) in the roughness slot and constant_roughness_min 0.3, max 1. In 0.26g a material's "roughness" is its gloss: stock glass has 0.7 to 1, cloth and skin 0.1, flora/grass 0.01; the G-buffer shader (gbuffer_pass.ps) writes 1 - (min + range x the map's green) and the sun's highlight (composition.ps) takes that as its GGX roughness. Stock grass_l03_alt's own map is near black, gloss 0.04 on average: a broad highlight of about 0.04 x the sun. The colour texture is 0.23 on the blades, gloss 0.46: a sharp highlight of about 3 x the sun, and the tufts' X-Ray normals all point up, so a whole patch takes the sun's colour where the player looks toward the sun and down. Both ends of the range are 0.04 now, stock grass_l03_alt's average, whatever the texture: the highlight is stock grass's; colour, translucency and shadows as they were. Visual only. Training Camp's meadow grass (ported/v010b/flora/grass_l03_alt, the same 0.3 and its colour texture) is another material and is not changed here.
